A Rift-touched winter wolf whose frost breath carries the absolute cold of the Veil — a chill that numbs not just flesh but memory and emotion. Packs of rift-winter-wolves roam the high passes and the northern margins of the Severed Lands, their howls said to mimic the sound of worlds cracking apart.
## Traits
**Keen Hearing and Smell.** Advantage on Perception relying on hearing or smell.
**Pack Tactics.** Advantage if ally within 5 feet.
**Snow Camouflage.** Advantage on Stealth checks in snowy terrain.

## Actions
**Bite.** +6 to hit, 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing. If the target is a creature, DC 14 STR save or prone.
**Cold Breath.** 15-foot cone, DC 12 DEX, 18 (4d8) cold (half on success). Recharges 5-6.
